en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, austere Baroque/Neoclassical building complex on a corner, with an attached church featuring a tall tower and spire crowned by a cross. The building has three stories with many identical rectangular windows and a modest cornice. Leafless young trees line the cobblestone street in front. Numerous people, including many children in dark winter clothing, stand along the sidewalk. The overall scene suggests a European town in the late 19th or early 20th century. A small street sign is visible on the corner of the building but is not clearly legible.
